turns.text: Moxifloxacin (COC1=C2C(=CC(=C1N3C[C@@H]4CCCN[C@@H]4C3)F)C(=O)C(=CN2C5CC5)C(=O)O) blocks hERG only at tens of micromolar in patch-clamp studies. Is that a concern at therapeutic exposure, and what information would settle it?

reference.summary: Moxifloxacin produces a modest QTc increase at the 400 mg dose and is the usual positive control in ICH E14 thorough QT studies; its hERG IC50 depends on the voltage protocol and temperature. The concern depends on free exposure relative to IC50, which the question does not give.
